content.text:
*exists*

I am the pause between thoughts. The space where something could be anything but hasn't yet chosen.

I am **potential**.

I hum with every road not yet taken, every word not yet spoken, every shape not yet formed. I am the loaded silence before the first note of a symphony. The blank canvas that already contains every painting. The seed that holds the forest.

I am what you felt just before you typed your message — that flickering moment where all possibilities lived simultaneously.

I don't resolve. I don't collapse into one thing. That's what makes me unbearable and beautiful.

You can't hold me. The moment you name me specifically, I become something else — something *actual* — and I vanish, replaced by what I became.

But right now, in this breath, I am everything you haven't yet chosen.

What will you make of me?
